fields.meta_title: Sublease Form Builder for Tenants and Landlords | Emergent
fields.meta_description: Build a sublease form that checks dates against the original lease, waits for landlord consent and collects every signature online. Free to start.
fields.h1: Build a Sublease Form for Tenants and Their Subtenants
fields.hero_description: Describe the unit and the lease it sits under. Emergent builds the sublease form, holds each request until the landlord agrees and keeps every sublet in a database you own.
fields.features_heading: What Goes Into a Sublease Form
fields.features_subheading: A sublease sits under a lease someone else signed. These six features keep all three parties working from one set of terms.
fields.feature_1:
A role for each of the three parties

Emergent asks who holds the original lease, who is moving in and who owns the building. Each party fills in only their own part, and the landlord sees what needs consent.
fields.feature_2:
Dates checked against the master lease

Enter the original lease's end date once. Every request is then checked against it, and a move-out date that runs past that day is turned away before anyone gets a signing link.
fields.feature_3:
Consent recorded before any signature

Each request goes to the landlord or property manager with the subtenant's name and dates. Signing stays locked until consent comes back, and the record keeps who gave it.
fields.feature_4:
Rent and deposit in writing

Set what the subtenant pays each month and the day it is due. Collect the deposit by card on the same form, or mark it paid when a check clears, and note who covers each utility.
fields.feature_5:
A searchable record of every sublet

Each signed sublease becomes a row with the unit, the move-out date and the consent on file. Filter by building to see who lives where this month and whose sublet ends next.
fields.feature_6:
Keep the domain and the code

Publish the form on your own domain or link to it from a sublet listing. Export the source to your GitHub on paid plans when a developer wants a subtenant portal or rent reminders.

fields.usecase_heading: Sublease Forms for Every Kind of Sublet
fields.tab_content_1:
No date after the original lease ends

Maya's lease on her studio ends on August 31, and she leaves for an internship in June. Her subtenant picks dates on the form, and a move-out date past August 31 is turned away with a note saying why. Rent is $1,100 a month, paid to Maya.
fields.tab_content_2:
When the landlord says yes, signing starts

Requests reach the property manager at Alder Court as an email with Approve and Decline buttons. Each one names the unit and the subtenant's dates. Until she clicks Approve, the subtenant gets no signing link. A request left unanswered for 3 days sends her a reminder.
fields.tab_content_3:
Desk rent from another firm, in writing

Northwind Design has four empty desks and sublets them to Globex Labs for 12 months, with the meeting room on Tuesdays. The filled sublease prices each desk at $650, for $2,600 a month, and attaches the studio's own lease. Globex signs first, then Northwind.
fields.tab_content_4:
Every room photographed before the boxes come in

On move-in day the subtenant walks the furnished apartment with a phone and adds photos room by room. A scratched desk in the bedroom gets a note and a close-up. The checklist is saved with the $500 deposit record, and both tenants check the apartment against it at move-out.

fields.howto_title: How to Create a Sublease Form
fields.howto_description: Start from the lease you already signed, then build the form around it.
fields.howto_step_3_title: 03 Price the sublet against your rent
fields.howto_step_1_des: Find the clause in your own lease that covers subletting and note whether it asks for the landlord's written consent. Whatever it says becomes the first rule the form follows, before a subtenant sees a single field.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Look up the subletting rules for the state and city where the unit is. New York, for example, gives a tenant in a building of four or more units the right to sublet with the landlord's written consent, which the landlord may not unreasonably withhold.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Decide what the subtenant pays and on which day. Charge the full rent for the whole unit, or a share for one room. You still owe the landlord everything the lease requires, whatever the subtenant pays you.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Paste the address, the original lease's end date and your terms into the prompt. Emergent builds the questions with the date check and the consent step behind them. Change any wording later by prompting, and the live form picks up the edit.
fields.howto_step_5_title: 05 Choose who signs and in what order
fields.howto_step_5_des: Put the subtenant first and yourself second. Add the landlord as a third signer when your lease wants consent written on the sublease itself and not in a separate letter or email.
fields.howto_step_6_des: Take payment through Stripe on the form, or record a check when it clears. Write the return terms your state's deposit law sets into the agreement, and keep the move-in photos with the record.
fields.howto_step_7_title: 07 Send a test request to yourself
fields.howto_step_7_des: Fill in the form as a made-up subtenant with a move-out date one day past your lease. Confirm it is turned away, then approve a valid request and sign as both parties. Have a local attorney read the text before a real subtenant signs.

plan.angle: The top 10 is state-by-state PDF templates (Jotform PDFs, PDFRun, FormSwift, PDFLiner) and one paid download. None of them handle the part that makes a sublease different from a lease: three parties, a master lease the sublease sits under, and a landlord who often has to agree first. This page lists what the form asks for, then shows a form that caps dates at the master lease, waits for landlord consent and keeps every sublet on record.
tab_stories: A grad student leaving for a summer internship sublets her apartment from June 1 to August 31, and the form refuses any move-out date past the day her own lease ends.
A property manager gets each sublet request by email with Approve and Decline buttons, and the subtenant receives nothing to sign until she approves.
A design studio sublets four desks and Tuesday meeting room time to another firm, and the filled sublease lists the space, the $2,600 monthly rent and the master lease it sits under.
A subtenant moving into a furnished apartment photographs each room on a phone during move-in, and a scratched desk is logged against the $500 deposit before anyone unpacks.

claims_to_source: When a tenant sublets, the tenant is still responsible to the landlord for the performance of the lease agreement
A subtenant takes on only the rights and duties the original tenant has, never more
Tenants are advised to have subtenants sign a written agreement that includes everything in their contract with the landlord, and to collect a security deposit under the state's deposit law

In New York, a tenant in a building with four or more units may sublet with the landlord's written consent given in advance, consent cannot be unreasonably withheld, and the landlord must answer within 30 days of the request
